title: notACMS Page Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter for static page Markdown files (*.md inside pages/ directories). All platform-defined fields are listed; themes may add custom fields freely.

title.description: Page title. Shown in <h1>, <title>, og:title, and navigation (unless menu.label overrides it).

slug.description: Full URL path for this locale, e.g. about or kontakt. The locale URL prefix (e.g. /pl/) is added automatically by the router. Do not include the leading slash.

description.description: Short description. Used as meta description and og:description. Recommended on all pages.

image.description: Path to the featured image WebP file, e.g. /media/my-page/featured.webp. Used in og:image and the page header.

image_alt.description: Alt text for the featured image. Required when image is set. Must visually describe the image.

toc.description: Controls the Table of Contents. Omit to use the default behavior. Set true to force-show; set false to suppress. Default: false.

dynamic.description: If true, the page is skipped during static pre-rendering and always served live by Symfony. Default: false.

template.description: Twig template to render this page with, without the .html.twig extension, e.g. page/about or page/doc. Default: page/default.

menu.description: Navigation entry for this page. Omit entirely to exclude the page from the nav.

weight.description: Navigation sort order. Lower values appear earlier. Default: 50.

label.description: Text shown in the navigation link. Defaults to the page title if omitted.
